title: geranium cinereum subsp. subcaulescens
intro: Geranium cinereum subsp. subcaulescens, commonly known as Alpine Cranesbill or Small-flowered Geranium, is a flowering plant species in the Geraniaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Geranium cinereum subsp. subcaulescens are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
